scripts.dev: npm run build -w @gradion-folio/contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names frontend,backend --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build -w @gradion-folio/contracts && npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w @gradion-folio/contracts && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gradion-folio/contracts && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gradion-folio/contracts && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @gradion-folio/contracts && npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend && eslint scripts
scripts.test: npm run build -w @gradion-folio/contracts && npm test -w frontend && npm test -w backend
